mentions.name: Micro-positioning vacuum-stage control driver
mentions.description: A control driver for a micro-positioning vacuum stage, built quickly using off-the-shelf Xilinx Zynq 7020 dev boards instead of spinning a custom PCB or hand-optimizing LUT counts for smaller prototypes.
mentions.source_excerpt: Picked up some more small Xilinx Zynq 7020 dev boards for a quick micro-positioning vacuum-stage control driver.  Yeah it was lazy, but I don't have time to spin a custom PCB board these days... or hand optimize LUT counts to fit smaller prototypes.
